content.title: About
content.content: The Bear is a soft plush toy made from hypoallergenic synthetic fleece. It is suitable for children aged 3 and up and serves as a perfect companion for sleep and play. The toy is filled with safe polypropylene fiber that retains shape and softness even after prolonged use.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Plush bears first appeared in Europe in the early 19th century.
Bears are believed to bring luck and comfort children during bedtime.
In Japan, “kinder bears” that emit gentle sounds when pressed are popular.
Bears are often used in therapy to reduce anxiety in children with autism.
The United States hosts an annual “Teddy Fest” where plush bear collectors gather.

items.title: Tactile development
items.content: The soft surface promotes sensory skill development in toddlers.

items.title: Emotional support
items.content: Having a favorite plush companion helps children cope with stress and fears.

items.title: Imagination boost
items.content: The bear encourages role‑play scenarios, fostering creative thinking.

items.title: Social skills
items.content: Play with plush characters aids the development of communication and empathy.

items.title: Safety
items.content: Hypoallergenic material minimizes the risk of allergic reactions.

items.title: Allergy to synthetic fleece
items.content: A small number of children may experience a reaction to the toy’s material.

items.title: Choking hazard
items.content: Small parts (e.g., eyes) can detach and pose a risk for children under 3 years old.

items.title: Wear and tear
items.content: With prolonged use the fleece may mat, requiring gentle washing or replacement.

items.title: Heat discomfort
items.content: Do not leave the bear in direct sunlight or near a heater to avoid overheating.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: The bear can be cuddled, placed in a crib, used in role‑playing games, or serve as a decorative element in a nursery. If needed, it can be machine‑washed on a gentle cycle at no more than 30 °C.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the bear in a dry place away from direct sunlight. For long‑term storage, place it in a fabric bag to prevent dust buildup.
